notes.title: Online Play Functionality
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added online play functionality
[/list]

* Players are able to host and join their own games online through internet play. After hosting a game, players can click "Join Online" to join the online game.

notes.title: 1.4.1 GPS Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Introducing GPS coordinate on the map
[*] Further optimization
[*] Switched to 32-bit version
[/list]
* Some players weren't able to play on the 64-bit version, so we switched to 32-bit.

notes.title: Small update - teleport
notes.content:
Small update will minor fixes and features
- teleport ability
- building fixes

You are now able to teleport using command teleport.player (player is the name of the player). The player can allow teleport by activating using 't' key. Pressing again deactivates teleport.
